channel.title: The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine (thecenterformichigan.net)

item.title: Where Michigan gubernatorial candidates stand on data centers
item.description: Bridge Michigan asked gubernatorial candidates for their stance on the hot-button issue of data centers, amid concerns surrounding Benson’s familial and professional connections to a data center developer. Here’s what they said.

item.title: Data center moratoriums pile up in Michigan. No one knows if they’ll work
item.description: No fewer than 19 communities have paused data center development, while bipartisan lawmakers push to repeal policies that have lured the industry to Michigan.

item.title: St. Clair County makes it easier for parents to opt out of vaccines
item.description: The health department announced a streamlined approach Monday to expedite vaccine waivers and reminded families they can opt out of the state’s data reporting system.

item.title: Benson, James, Duggan grow money momentum in Michigan governor race
item.description: Democrat Jocelyn Benson and Republican John James are raising big money in their run for Michigan governor. But independent Mike Duggan's campaign raised the most from donors last year.

item.title: Newly opened Kirk Gibson Center fights Parkinson’s — and isolation in Michigan
item.description: After diagnosis, Tigers legend Kirk Gibson builds a team of members and caregivers.

item.title: Michigan program helps farms continue by connecting buyers with sellers
item.description: American farmers are getting older and looking to retire, but fewer young people want into the business. The MiFarmLink program helps make connections to preserve agricultural land and operations.

item.title: Prison officer assaults up in Michigan. Union asks state for change
item.description: Assaults against Michigan prison staff have increased in recent years, particularly at facilities that house high-security inmates, which correctional officers attribute to a shortage of maximum-security space.

item.title: Animal rights group sues Michigan over coyote killing seasons
item.description: Humane World for Animals says the Michigan Natural Resources Commission’s vote to allow year-round coyote killing is not based on science.

item.title: Michigan cutting the cord at record rates, as cable subscribers fall below 1M
item.description: Cable television subscribers fell below 1 million in Michigan in 2025, as concerns about the cost of streaming services are increasing.

item.title: Group touts signatures to put citizenship, voter ID question on Michigan ballot
item.description: A group pushing to tighten Michigan voter ID rules and require proof of citizenship to register says it has collected enough signatures to make the Michigan ballot. State officials will still need to validate petitions.
